title: Unity on the QA VM and the scripted editor smoke task
summary: Install the pinned Unity version on the QA Bot's VM and prove one unattended scripted task: open the project, import the sample splat, open the sample scene, capture a screenshot, write a report. This is the QA half of the M0 exit test.

acceptance_tests.test: Installed Unity version equals unity/ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt; iOS build support module installed.

qa/scripts/editor_smoke.py runs Unity -batchmode with an editor script under unity/Assets/Editor/QA/ that opens the project, imports the sample splat, opens the sample scene, captures a Game-view screenshot to qa/evidence/M0-QA-01/, and writes qa/reports/M0-editor-smoke.md with timings and versions.
The task runs end to end unattended twice in a row with identical pass results (two logs attached).
Screenshot contains no faces, documents, or personal data (privacy check line in the report).

references: kit START M0 (Unity installed on QA VM, one scripted task proven)

in-progress -> done (gj-operator; direct commit to main, Operator precedent). The smoke now runs on the M0-UNITY-02 splat sample. EditorSmoke's import step regenerates the procedural sample (PLY into Temp/) and converts it with the renderer's importer into Assets/Capture/Samples; the re-import must be byte-identical to the committed asset. The scene step opens SplatSample.unity and requires a GaussianSplatRenderer with a valid asset and GPU data. The capture step renders a splat-off baseline and then the real frame, and fails if under 1% of pixels change. Graphics: the renderer's compute shaders need DXC with wave intrinsics, which OpenGL Core cannot run, so editor_smoke.py now runs Vulkan on Mesa lavapipe (-force-vulkan -force-device-index 0; mesa-vulkan-drivers installed on the QA box). Two unattended runs with Unity 6000.0.84f1 (78ab6fc243d5) + iOS Build Support: both PASS, exit 0, 12.1 s wall each, 0 errors / 0 exceptions / 0 compile errors, console 0/0 on open, identical step results. 38,460 splats; 31.37% of the frame is splat. AT-1 met (version match, iOS module installed; report header). AT-3 met: two identical PASS runs. The sanitized logs are now committed as qa/reports/M0-QA-01/run-1.txt and run-2.txt; the repo's *.log ignore rule meant the 2026-09-26 run-N.log files named in the report never landed in git.
